tools.name: get_reward_deadlines
tools.description: The next FTSO delegation reward deadlines on Flare and Songbird: when each closes, how many tokens are still unclaimed network-wide (they are burned at the deadline), and what the last deadline burned. Network totals only, not about any one wallet.

tools.name: get_ftso_providers
tools.description: Registered FTSO providers on Flare or Songbird with each one’s measured delegator reward rate (annualised, after its fee, over recent reward epochs), fee, delegated vote power and whether it is over the vote-power cap. tools.name: check_claimable_rewards
tools.description: FTSO delegation rewards an address can claim right now on Flare and/or Songbird, read from the RewardManager contract: total, how many reward epochs, and when the oldest one expires. Read-only: nothing is signed or stored. Claiming has to be done by the owner in their own wallet.
